title: Bioelectrode–metal synergistic interaction for hydrogen recovery in a sulfate-reducing bacteria-based bioelectrochemical system to treat sewage wastewater: microbial dynamics and feasibility study under continuous-mode operation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,849-865
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00936G, Paper
Renju, Rajesh Singh
This study validated a 1 L-capacity sulfate-reducing bacteria-based bioelectrochemical system (SRB-BES) for treating sewage wastewater in continuous mode over ∼66 days.
